fact: The Treasury (DGTCP) announced on 19 December 2025 that a new 'e-Procurement' platform will replace SIGMAP and the public procurement web portal, under decree 2025-169 of 9 April 2025 setting up the electronic public procurement information system, with its modules presented and implementation at a progress-review stage.
ARMP says the SIGMaP web platform for public procurement has run since 2015, and 757 calls to tender were published on it in 2023.
ARMP says the e-procurement platform is still being acquired and implemented, under Decree 2025-169 of 9 April 2025, with training of public buyers running 6 October to 28 November 2025.
A 2024 evaluation cited by ARMP found that of 757 calls published in 2023 on SIGMaP only 21 reached the automatic contract page.
On 24 June 2025 the ARMP launched an international open tender to acquire and deploy an electronic public-procurement solution covering the cycle from planning to execution, bids due 6 August 2025.
